description: This file contains the implementation of Timer management within the Orleans framework. It defines interfaces and classes for managing single-shot timers, including delayed execution, timer registration, and queue management for timers across multiple threads. Key components include ITimerManager interface, TimerManager and TimerManager<T> generic class, and internal classes for timer callbacks and linked list management. The file facilitates efficient timer scheduling, expiration, and notification mechanisms in a distributed environment.

classes.name: TimerManagerImpl
classes.description: Internal class implementing ITimerManager interface, providing a delay method that delegates to TimerManager.Delay.

classes.name: TimerManager
classes.description: Static class providing timer delay functionalities like Delay and DelayUntil, managing timer expiration.

classes.name: DelayTimer
classes.description: Private sealed class representing individual timer instances, with completion tasks and callback handling.

classes.name: TimerManager<T>
classes.description: Generic static class managing queues of timers for a specific timer callback type, handling registration, expiration, and thread-local queues.

classes.name: ThreadLocalQueue
classes.description: Represents per-thread timer queue data, including lock, queue elements, and starvation count.

classes.name: ExpiredTimers
classes.description: Manages timers that have expired and need to be fired, implementing linked list interface.

methods.name: Delay
methods.description: Static method to create a delay that completes after a specified TimeSpan or when canceled.

methods.name: DelayUntil
methods.description: Creates a delay until a specific DateTime.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a timer with the internal queue management system.
